verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents flag creation, a $0 forever tier with unlimited flags, and environments through production. Community users describe clients streaming flag changes live, so creating and toggling a flag in production is clearly supported. The 'within minutes of signing up' part is unevidenced: no quickstart, onboarding flow, or time-to-first-flag data appears, and the one hands-on adoption report describes a 24-hour hackathon rather than minutes. Missing for 10: documented quickstart or signup-to-first-toggle flow, evidence of minutes-level time-to-value, independent hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Create as many feature flags as you need and target them by user, segment, or rule.
Environments allow you to manage your feature flags throughout your entire development lifecycle, from local development through production.
LaunchDarkly clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
They implemented most of LD during a 24-hour hackathon.
